title: b4 fork: vouch-check.sh header matches the guides
description: Critic 2026-10-23: ~/PROJECT/b4 branch git-vouch misc/vouch-check.sh header shows only the patatt pip line, puts vouch: under b4.keyringsrc, and says the recheck setting is not in released b4.
